title: Clean Energy Demonstration Transparency Act of 2025
short_title: Clean Energy Demonstration Transparency Act of 2025
committees: S-Energy and Natural Resources Committee: Referred To 2025-05-20 || H-Science, Space, and Technology Committee: Referred To 2025-02-21
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
summary: Clean Energy Demonstration Transparency Act of 2025 This bill directs the Department of Energy (DOE) to submit and publish online semiannual reports on the status of certain clean energy demonstration projects that are managed or supported by DOE's Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
